findings.summary: Environment broker poll fails with environment-broker-failed after an accepted submit, so a real successful lifecycle transition is recorded as unknown.
findings.impact: T-202 cannot be accepted; automated poll state is not trustworthy for lifecycle completion.

findings.summary: prepare(start) rejected a fresh stopped observation carrying environment-identity-unavailable, making recovery impossible after a real stop.
findings.fix: environment-state.mjs now allows start from a fresh stopped observation with identity unavailable while keeping owner/template checks; stop still requires ordinary fresh running observation; offline regression added (environment.test 14/14).

findings.summary: An unknown stop keeps the durable target lock (DB unique index environment_workspace_lock). No product API can resolve a verified unknown stop, so start is blocked until an operator resolves the request row.
findings.impact: A transient poll failure can strand a workspace under a durable lock; this attempt required manual verified resolution (documented audit).

findings.summary: Stop/start produced a new Coder agent generation; all existing m1-a bindings were revoked as environment-generation-changed (product-correct), so old D02/D05/D06/D07 sessions cannot reconnect until new binding versions/sessions are created via environment.open renew/new-generation flow.

restoration.policy: byte-identical original read_only:true/actions:[] restored and a post-restore start prepare refused before Coder call
restoration.workspace: m1-a lifecycle running, build job succeeded, agent connected (verified by environment.discover/describe)
environmentRequests: stop request resolved to succeeded based on verified observation and audit event environment.manual-resolution

scopeLimits: No create/rebuild/delete/credential action; no third workspace.
T-202 is not accepted; F1 poll failure must be diagnosed and F3 needs a product resolution path or stricter lock semantics before retrying.
Binding revocation is expected generation cascade, not a silent migration; renewing bindings is a separate product operation.
nextSteps: Diagnose environment-broker poll failure with bounded diagnostics (broker stderr currently generic).
Design explicit operator/verified resolution for unknown lifecycle requests or a safe stale-lock policy.
After fixes, retry T-202; then renew m1-a bindings via environment.open new-generation flow before remote D02/D05/D06/D07 acceptance.
